source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The sensor board receives two input connections from the main board: one 4-pin JST-PH 2.0mm connector for power (5V, GND, 3V3, GND), plus one 6-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] 1.25mm connector carrying the signals (SDA0, SCL0, SDA1, SCL1, UART TX, UART RX).
It also provides these output connectors for the individual sensor modules:

- SCD41 — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] (3V3/GND/SDA0/SCL0)
- BME280 — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]
- ENS160 — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]
- SPS30 — 5-pin JST-ZH 1.5mm (5V, SDA0, SCL0, SEL→GND, GND); this uses a different connector type to match the SPS30 cable
- ZE08-CH2O — 7-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002], matching the supplied cable
- I2C display — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002] (3V3/GND/SDA1/SCL1)
- One spare I2C0 port — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]
- One spare I2C1 port — 4-pin JST-[FREELANCER_NAME_002]

That makes 10 connectors in total. The complete pinouts are provided in the sensor board doc.
